children: Cactus furnished investor presentation summarizing recent acquisitions, 2026 financials and Q3 segment guidance.
Posted investor presentation (Exhibit 99.1) on its website ahead of investor meetings under Regulation FD.
Reports Q2 2026 cash of approximately $366M and about $224M revolver availability plus $100M undrawn term loan.
YTD 2026 annualized revenue mix: Pressure Control 77%, Spoolable Technologies 23%; strong Adjusted EBITDA margins cited.
Q3 2026 outlook: Pressure Control revenue down low-double-digits vs Q2 with 23–25% Adj. EBITDA margin.
Q3 2026 outlook: Spoolable Technologies revenue up ~20% vs Q2 with 39–41% Adj. EBITDA margin; ~$5M corporate charge expected.
